subject: english
question:
**Change the following sentence into the Active form.**

The championship game was won by our team.

options.text: Our team won the championship game.
The championship game was winning our team. team.
Our team wins the championship game.
The championship game had been won by our team.

solution:
The correct answer is '1' i.e. Our team won the championship game.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• The given sentence is in the **passive voice**. Passive voice emphasizes the action or the object receiving the action rather than the subject performing it.
 
• To change a sentence from passive to active voice, identify the subject performing the action and place it at the beginning of the sentence.
 
• The structure of active voice is **Subject + Verb + Object**.
 
• In the sentence, "The championship game was won by our team," the subject performing the action is "our team," the verb is "won," and the object is "the championship game."

Correct sentence: *Our team won the championship game.*

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• **Passive Voice:**
 
 
• **Structure:** Object + to be (correct tense) + past participle + by + subject.
 
• **Example:** The book was read by the teacher.
 
• **Usage:** Used when the focus is on the action or the object receiving the action.
 
 
 
• **Active Voice:**
 
 
• **Structure:** Subject + Verb + Object.
 
• **Example:** The teacher read the book.
 
• **Usage:** Used when the focus is on the subject performing the action.
